hoursNote.a: PowerPyx: about 200 hours to the platinum [2].
hoursNote.call: Our call: budget 200–300 hours. The story is 60–80 hours; the rest is the 100% checklist and cleanup.

stages.name: Stage 1 — Story, and start the long counts

steps.text: Play the story chapter by chapter, Chapters 1 to 5, in order — the chapter trophies pop as each one closes.
FIRST, in Chapter 1, do the missable meditation: after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and choose Accept.
Keep a separate save at the start and the end of every chapter — ten slots in all — so a missed step never costs a replay.
Scan every new vehicle model and study every new animal with binoculars as you meet them; the checklist needs 200 of 277 vehicles and 100 of 255 animals.
Try each activity type you pass — fishing, races, the shooting range, drone races, arcade games — because Master of None needs all nine tried once.
Never turn cheats on: cheats disable trophies and saving on that save.
Finish the Chapter 3 missions VCIA Takedown and Headliners, and the Chapter 4 mission Operation Savage Glory — each has its own trophy.
Complete the final mission in Chapter 5 for the gold trophy, then open the 100% Completion Checklist under Progress, then Stats.

stages.trophies: Just Like Paradise, Paradise Lost, T**s Ass Drug Money, Vice City, Baby!, Top Of The World, Ma, You Gotta Know When to Get Off, Trust, Break the Bank, Family Matters, DWNFALL, Hi-Jacked, Snow Storm, Positive Mental Attitude (first meditation)

stages.name: Stage 2 — The 100% checklist and the 70 challenges

steps.text: Open the 100% Completion Checklist under Progress, then Stats, and work it row by row — it is only about 60% true completion, so most side quests are not required.
Complete 70 of the 80 Challenges; the other 10 can be skipped, so pick the easiest 70 first.
Finish the vehicle scan count (200 of 277 models) and the animal study count (100 of 255) if the story left them short.
Clear the robbery counts for 100%: 39 Gang Operations, 22 Bank Jobs, 7 Payday Loan Jobs and 8 bank vault robberies.
Find the 33 underwater discoveries and the 100 Cocaine Flamingos listed in the checklist rows.
Complete 15 of the 18 collectible card sets — the checklist needs 15, while the trophy only needs 3.
Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges, and win the 14 Top Fun drone races.
When the checklist hits 100%, the gold trophy A Long Road pops — the hardest trophy in the game.

stages.trophies: A Long Road, Cunning Stunts, The Shootist, Top Fun, One Last Thing, Whip It Good, Don't Touch My Deck, You WAiNKer!

stages.name: Stage 3 — Strangers & Freaks and the cleanup

steps.text: Work the stranger markers on the map: finish all 8 stranger mission strands, one per stranger.
Complete the final mission of each strand — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each have their own trophy.
Hunt the unique animal for Bret as part of his strand, studying it with binoculars first.
Mop up the remaining collectibles: the last meditation spots, WAiNK locations, card sets and garage properties.
Finish the remaining activity trophies — races, fishing against Cal, arcade games, robberies and the wanted-level escapes.
Spend and launder your way through the money trophies: $100,000 spent across shops and $250,000 of Marked Bills laundered.
Try the unconfirmed hidden trophies last — Ocean Beach cocktails, the showroom smash, the retry and the strange event — and expect some to stay unconfirmed.
When the 54th other trophy pops, the platinum Vice Got a Price! unlocks automatically.

stages.trophies: Strangers & Freaks, Road to Rehabilitation, This Was No Boat Accident, The Lone Rider, Supply & Demand, Spin On This!, Fair Game, Vice Got a Price!
